evidence.transcription: 9.2.9 PRIMARY ENDPOINT “IN FULL CLINICAL REMISSION”. The binary variable “In full clinical remission” is defined as: If CKDepi_mean(V16,V16_2) − CKDepi_mean(V1,R6) ≥ 5 or proteinuria_g/g ≥ 0.2 then “In full clinical remission” = 1 (event) and if CKDepi_mean(V16,V16_2) − CKDepi_mean(V1,R6) < 5 and proteinuria_g/g < 0.2 then “In full clinical remission” = 0 (no event). CKDepi_mean(V16,V16_2) is the mean of eGFR according CKDepi of visit 36 months and the results of repeated laboratory tests within one week after visit 36 months. CKDepi_mean(V1,R6) is the mean of eGFR according CKDepi of baseline and visit −1 week. Calculation of eGFR according CKDepi is described in 9.2.7 and proteinuria in g/g in 9.2.5.

Figure 2, panel A: In Full Clinical Remission. Columns: Subgroup; Supportive Care; Supportive Care plus Immunosuppression; Odds Ratio (95% CI); P Value. Counts are no. of events/total no. Full-analysis set: 4/80; 14/82; 4.82 (1.43–16.30); 0.01. Available-case analysis: 4/72; 14/71; 5.38 (1.55–18.66); 0.008. Odds-ratio axis ticks: 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20. Below 1: Supportive Care Better; above 1: Supportive Care plus Immunosuppression Better.

proposed_results.relation_rationale: Select Figure 2A's full-analysis-set adjusted OR 4.82 (95% CI 1.43–16.30), P=0.01, for the reported first hierarchical primary endpoint at 3 years: 14/82 versus 4/80. The report's prose endpoint matches the requested remission construct and time; its logistic model adjusts for baseline eGFR and proteinuria. The non-exact related classification preserves unresolved correspondence because the original protocol used proteinuria <0.2 g/day and measured clearance, later changed to g/g and CKD-EPI eGFR, while SAP section 9.2.9 prints event coding and an end-minus-baseline GFR difference inconsistent with its prose definition. Do not assume which calculation was implemented. Prefer the principal full-analysis result over the available-case sensitivity OR 5.38 (1.55–18.66), which excludes missing observations, and over the distinct second primary endpoint eGFR decrease ≥15. The latter is context, not a substitute. All inspected outcome-designation sources expressly list primary endpoints; an absence of a designated primary endpoint is not established. Current registry bytes are dated augmentation, not historical replay.

reported.analysis_population: Full-analysis set of all 162 randomized patients: 82 immunosuppression plus supportive care and 80 supportive care alone; missing primary endpoint data classified as no remission. This is an analyzed population, not 162 observed endpoint measurements.

proposed_results.requested_outcome: Full clinical remission at the end of the 3-year trial phase (first of two hierarchical primary end points; second is decrease in eGFR of ≥15 ml/min/1.73 m2)

comparison_groups.assignment: Supportive care plus immunosuppressive therapy, regimen determined by baseline eGFR.

target.intended_analysis_population: All randomized participants in the comparison groups
target.intended_effect_measure: Adjusted odds ratio for remission, immunosuppression plus supportive care versus supportive care alone

measurement.method: Full clinical remission: protein-to-creatinine ratio <0.2 g/g AND decline in CKD-EPI eGFR <5 ml/min/1.73 m2 from randomization baseline.
measurement.metric: Full clinical remission at the end of the 3-year trial phase (first of two hierarchical primary end points; second is decrease in eGFR of ≥15 ml/min/1.73 m2)

target.outcome_definition: Full clinical remission at the end of the 3-year trial phase (first of two hierarchical primary end points; second is decrease in eGFR of ≥15 ml/min/1.73 m2)

time_point_or_window.description: At the final visit at the end of the 3-year randomized trial phase, following the 6-month run-in.
